title: Glowing strawberry
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5577' stop-opacity='1'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ff2244' stop-opacity='0.8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff2244' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='body' cx='45%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6677'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#ee2244'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#bb1133'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='highlight' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb3cc' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb3cc' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- outer glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='38' ry='38' fill='url(#glow)' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- strawberry body -->
  <path d='M50 25
           C30 25, 18 38, 20 55
           C22 72, 35 84, 50 88
           C65 84, 78 72, 80 55
           C82 38, 70 25, 50 25 Z'
        fill='url(#body)' stroke='#ff8899' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- lighter edge shade -->
  <path d='M50 25
           C30 25, 18 38, 20 55
           C22 72, 35 84, 50 88
           C65 84, 78 72, 80 55
           C82 38, 70 25, 50 25 Z'
        fill='none' stroke='#ff99aa' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='42' rx='12' ry='16' fill='url(#highlight)'/>

  <!-- seeds -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='48' r='2' fill='#ffeebb'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='42' r='2' fill='#ffeebb'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='50' r='2' fill='#ffeebb'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='58' r='2' fill='#ffeebb'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='62' r='2' fill='#ffeebb'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='62' r='2' fill='#ffeebb'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='72' r='2' fill='#ffeebb'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='72' r='2' fill='#ffeebb'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='54' r='2' fill='#ffeebb'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='2' fill='#ffeebb'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='35' r='2' fill='#ffeebb'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='36' r='2' fill='#ffeebb'/>

  <!-- leaves -->
  <path d='M50 26 L38 18 L44 24 L34 24 L42 28 Z' fill='#33cc55' stroke='#66ee88' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M50 26 L62 18 L56 24 L66 24 L58 28 Z' fill='#33cc55' stroke='#66ee88' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M50 26 L50 14 L54 22 L46 22 Z' fill='#33cc55' stroke='#66ee88' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M50 26 L32 30 L40 28 L36 34 L44 30 Z' fill='#22aa44' stroke='#55dd77' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M50 26 L68 30 L60 28 L64 34 L56 30 Z' fill='#22aa44' stroke='#55dd77' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='47' y='10' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#33bb44' stroke='#66ee88' stroke-width='1'/>
</svg>
